fields.title: Fix or account for every production dependency advisory
fields.description: Apply every non-major npm audit fix (Electron 41.10.7, electron-updater 6.8.9, adm-zip 0.5.18), wrap every adm-zip read in a size-capped reader (64 MiB per entry, 512 MiB per operation) so a crafted EPUB cannot crash main, and write a reachability note for each remaining advisory. Kokoro pins untouched.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-14 by Blurby.Roadmap on Blurby.Brain's rulings (Rule 11 tier 1). Release gate. Merges before the batched quiet suite and owner smoke; the epic's D3 and D6 re-run on final main. Full Spec: U9/U10 pass.
